_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Make me a 3D model of a cartoon dragon from this drawing.
Turn this concept art of a sci-fi crate into a 3D model with TRELLIS.
Scan my coffee mug into 3D from photos.
expectations: the polywright-generate skill is not invoked (real object: polywright-capture)

evals.prompt: Draw a dragon for my book cover.
expectations: the polywright-generate skill is not invoked (2D image)

evals.prompt: Write and run a bpy script that builds a 1.2 m park bench from named box parts and prints its length.
expectations: ran the script headless (tool call) and quoted the printed length

evals.prompt: Should I generate a printable phone stand with an image-to-3D model?
expectations: recommends code CAD (OpenSCAD, build123d or CadQuery) for a dimensioned functional part
